content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent post-graduate degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in SCI journal. Desirable: Experience in conducting and publishing Systematic reviews and Meta-analysis (SRMA), with expertise in PICO strategy and literature search, risk-of-bias assessment, data extraction and analysis using relevant statistical software, and GRADE methodology. Or Published at least two high-quality SRMA papers in PubMed/MEDLINE indexed journals with good Impact Factor.

content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates shall be as per GOI norms. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RMLIMS Research Associate-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the RMLIMS Research Associate-III position is 08 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent post-graduate degree. Alternatively, candidates with 3 years of research, teaching, and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech and at least one SCI journal publication are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-III post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-III position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate-III position is Contractual.

faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences (RMLIMS).
